$sources: ASCE/SEI 7-22 Ch 31 (wind tunnel procedure), Sec 31.4.3 (limitations on loads); Commentary Table C26.7-1 (z0 of the exposures); see VERIFY.md
source: ASCE/SEI 7-22 Ch 31 (wind tunnel procedure); SAEngine practice for the number of directions
validation: ASCE 7-22 Ch 31 accepts wind loads from a boundary-layer wind tunnel test meeting its test conditions (Sec 31.2, by ASCE/SEI 49), the main wind-force resisting system's loads not below 80 % of the analytical procedure's (Sec 31.4.3). A CFD simulation is not such a test.

sources.directionStep: SAEngine practice: 12 directions every 30° (wind tunnel tests usually take 10° to 15°)
sources.roughness: ASCE 7-22 Commentary Table C26.7-1: typical z0 of exposures B, C, D
sources.lowerLimit: ASCE 7-22 Sec 31.4.3: the MWFRS loads at least 80 % of those of Part 1 of Ch 27 or Ch 28
